instruction: I want to change VLC's screenshot format from PNG to JPG to save disk space. How can I configure VLC to save screenshots in JPG format?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
